lines: {target}? Strange quiet can make a place feel too safe. I would trust solid blocks more than brave words.
If anyone heads for Mushroom Fields, tell them: Eat only what you know and keep your boat close. I will be at the stonecutter.
Mycelium underfoot is not village dirt. I will remember that when I check the walls.
Mushroom Fields is no small story. Stone remembers every bad step.
I will remember Mushroom Fields as odd land where even the grass changed its mind. I will keep spare blocks close.
{target}? Open ground shows you to everything else. I would trust solid blocks more than brave words.
If anyone heads for Plains, tell them: Keep moving and watch the horizon. I will be at the stonecutter.
Grass bends before trouble arrives if you look. I will remember that when I check the walls.
Plains is no small story. Stone remembers every bad step.
I will remember Plains as wide land with nowhere to hide after dark. I will keep spare blocks close.
{target}? Sunny fields can still point toward trouble. I would trust solid blocks more than brave words.
If anyone heads for Sunflower Plains, tell them: Enjoy the flowers with a torch ready. I will be at the stonecutter.
Sunflowers face light, not safety. I will remember that when I check the walls.
Sunflower Plains is no small story. Stone remembers every bad step.
I will remember Sunflower Plains as bright fields that still grow dark at night. I will keep spare blocks close.
